|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[V-4X-D Ski Speeder (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
* '''Original''' ([[V-4X-D Ski Speeder]], 7 January 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (8 January 2019). Players Committee card image, 7 January 2019: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-v4xdskispeeder-20190107.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/v4xdskispeeder.gif Holotable commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images”], no mark). Text: “May add 1 pilot. May move as a 'react'. Matching vehicle for any Resistance pilot. Pilot's power = 0, and when targeted by an Interrupt or weapon, may use this vehicle's defense value instead.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 22 March 2019): Players Committee card image, 22 March 2019: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-v4xdskispeeder-20190322.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0f91c9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/v4xdskispeeder.gif Holotable commit 0f91c9b “March 2019 Errata released”], mark “E”). Text: “May add 1 pilot. May move as a 'react'. Matching vehicle for any Resistance pilot. Pilot's power = 0, and if targeted by Force Lightning, Trample, or a weapon, may use this card's defense value instead.” '''What changed:''' “when targeted by an Interrupt or weapon, may use this vehicle's defense value instead” became “if targeted by Force Lightning, Trample, or a weapon, may use this card's defense value instead”.
*: [[File:V10-L-v4xdskispeeder-20190322-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[V-4X-D Ski Speeder (Errata 2)]], 19 August 2024): Players Committee card image, 19 August 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-v4xdskispeeder.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a20089e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/v4xdskispeeder.png Holotable commit a20089e “Virtual Set 10 Remastered”], mark “E1”). Text: “May add 1 pilot. May move as a 'react'. Matching vehicle for any Resistance pilot. Pilot's power = 0, and if targeted by Force Lightning, Trample, or a weapon, may use this card's defense value instead.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 10 remaster: new art (credit “Image courtesy of Ashwini Chandrasekhar”), new copyright line (“ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”), re-rendered at 745×1039 (was 350×490); same words; the mark is now “E1”. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
